parts.name: Fixed lateral trim steel plate (simulation design)
parts.basis: Fixed plate mass = -sum(original dry mass*y)/0.65 m. Balances nominal lateral first moment, not tuned to yaw results. Steel density 7850 kg/m3 engineering assumption; no measured or original-CAD claim. Same fixed plate in all loads/fuel levels, never auto-trimmed. Forward position selected on 0.25 m grid to reduce stern-heavy static trim while preserving >=0.05 m clearance to hull convex envelope; see docs/validation/distributed_drag_2026-11-21.
parts.coverage: New explicitly modelled plate, added once to dry hull ledger; not fuel or hidden residual

parts.name: Compact passive centreline stabilizer
parts.basis: Uniform solid aluminium engineering proxy, 2700 kg/m3; oriented mesh tetrahedral volume and inertia. Added hardware, not original measured vessel. Elliptical chord section, tapered last 30 mm. Root overlaps keel by less than 4 mm; attachment strength not certified.
parts.coverage: Additional hardware mass; not subtracted from prior hull budget. No electrical demand.

hydrodynamics.basis: Finite-aspect-ratio symmetric lift and induced drag, same law as existing appendages; no reverse-only gain. CD0=.03, e=.7 engineering assumptions; sensitivity required.

coverage_note: 70 accounting items in upgraded profile, including one lateral trim plate; four upgrade batteries and trays have explicit installation envelopes. Not a fabrication BOM or certified internal clearance.
